- Read and parse the list of old songs from the file "~/documents/personal/list_of_old_songs.txt".
- Access the user's Spotify playlists and prepare to manage songs (e.g., add or remove songs) based on the old songs list.
- Fetch detailed information (title, artist, album, genre, etc.) for all unique song_ids found in the user's playlists to enable matching with the old songs list.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use authenticated API calls requiring access tokens.
- Use the file_system and spotify apps with their respective credentials.
- Preserve exact file paths and API usage.
- The Spotify "show_song" API only supports fetching one song at a time, so calls must be made individually per song_id.
- The Spotify access token is stored in the variable `spotify_login["access_token"]`.
